# אינדקס מפלצות

בחרי שדות חיפוש. החזיקי `shift` או גררי עם העכבר לבחירה מרובה.

שם המפלצת הוא תמיד חלק משדה החיפוש.

```{ojs}
data = {
  const d = await FileAttachment("monsters.json").json()
  return d
}
```

```{ojs}
cols = Object.keys(data[0])
cols2 = cols.slice(1)
```

```{ojs}
// JS port of dice-he.lua. That filter is a Pandoc filter, so it only reaches
// markdown rendered by Quarto — this table is built client-side from
// monsters.json, which Pandoc never sees. Same rules, same markup, same CSS
// hooks (.dice / .mod in custom-rtl.css).
diceHe = {
  // Already-Hebrew dice are normalized to d-form first so one pattern covers
  // both. Digits are required around ק so we never hit the letter inside a word.
  const TO_D = [[/(\d+)ק(\d+)/g, "$1d$2"], [/(\d*)ק(%)/g, "$1d$2"]];

  // Count optional, sides are digits or %, modifier optional. The lookbehind is
  // the equivalent of Lua's %f[%w] frontier: it stops a match starting
  // mid-word. Hebrew letters are outside \w, so ...ק1d6 still matches.
  const RE = /(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(\d*)d(\d+|%)([+-]\d+)?/g;

  // Emit count, ק, sides and modifier as SEPARATE LTR atoms in source order.
  // .dice is RTL, so it flips them visually: count on the right, then ק, then
  // sides, then the modifier. Sides and modifier must not be grouped — "8+2"
  // would put the modifier digit next to ק and read as 9d2+8 instead of 9d8+2.
  function atom(s) {
    return htl.html`<span dir="ltr">${s}</span>`;
  }

  function wrap(count, sides, modifier) {
    const parts = [];
    if (count) parts.push(atom(count));
    parts.push("ק");
    parts.push(atom(sides));
    if (modifier) {
      // Sign and number stay separate so +1 reads as "+1" (not "1+") and +10
      // keeps its digit order (not "01").
      parts.push(htl.html`<span class="mod" dir="ltr">${modifier[0]}</span>`);
      parts.push(atom(modifier.slice(1)));
    }
    return htl.html`<span class="dice">${parts}</span>`;
  }

  return function diceHe(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
    let s = String(value);
    for (const [re, to] of TO_D) s = s.replace(re, to);

    const out = [];
    let pos = 0, m;
    RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = RE.exec(s)) !== null) {
      if (m.index > pos) out.push(s.slice(pos, m.index));
      out.push(wrap(m[1], m[2], m[3]));
      pos = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    if (pos === 0) return s;                    // nothing matched; leave as-is
    if (pos < s.length) out.push(s.slice(pos));
    return htl.html`<span>${out}</span>`;
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof theseCols =  Inputs.select(cols2, {multiple:true, value:cols2})
```

<br>

```{ojs}
viewof search  = {
  let n = Inputs.search(data,{
  columns:[cols[0]].concat(theseCols)
});
return n
}
```

<br>

::: {.column-screen .table-responsive}
```{ojs}
Inputs.table(search, {
  width: "auto",
  format: Object.fromEntries([
    // htl takes a function here, so the name never has to survive a trip
    // through an inline onclick string — names like סטריג' and ג'לי contain an
    // apostrophe that would terminate the JS literal early.
    [cols[0], id => htl.html`<a href="#" onclick=${e => { e.preventDefault(); test(id); }}>${id}</a>`],
    ...cols2.map(c => [c, diceHe])
  ])
})

```

:::


```{=html}
<script>

// monstersAll.html is large, so fetch and parse it once and reuse it.
var monsterDoc = null;

// Quarto's smart quotes turn the straight apostrophe in names like סטריג' and
// ג'לי into a curly one, so compare on a normalized form.
function normName(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/[‘’ʼ]/g, "'").replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function findMonster($doc, name) {
  var target = normName(name);
  var $blocks = $doc.filter('.monster').add($doc.find('.monster'));

  // The index names come verbatim from the stat-table header cells, so an exact
  // match there is unambiguous — a substring scan over the whole block sends
  // short names like שלד or עוג to whichever monster happens to mention them.
  var $hit = $blocks.filter(function() {
    return $(this).find('th').toArray().some(function(th) {
      return normName($(th).text()) === target;
    });
  }).first();

  if (!$hit.length) {
    $hit = $blocks.filter(function() {
      return $(this).find('h2, h3, h4').toArray().some(function(h) {
        return normName($(h).text()) === target;
      });
    }).first();
  }

  if (!$hit.length) {
    $hit = $blocks.filter(function() {
      return normName($(this).text()).indexOf(target) !== -1;
    }).first();
  }

  return $hit;
}

function showMonster($doc, name) {
  var $hit = findMonster($doc, name);
  $('#myModal .modal-title').text(name);
  $('#myModal .modal-body').html($hit.length ? $hit.html() : 'לא נמצא תיאור עבור ' + name);
  $('#myModal').modal('show');
}

function test(name) {
  if (monsterDoc) {
    showMonster(monsterDoc, name);
    return;
  }
  $.get('monstersAll.html', function(data) {
    monsterDoc = $(data);
    showMonster(monsterDoc, name);
  });
}
</script>
```
